packageRules.description: Hold every major version bump for manual review — majors carry breaking changes (e.g. OkHttp 5, Retrofit 3, Compose BOM 2026). Surface under Pending Approval and create deliberately; minors/patches keep flowing on schedule.

HELD — coordinated toolchain upgrade. Kotlin, KSP and Dagger/Hilt are coupled: KSP is locked to the Kotlin compiler, and Hilt's bundled metadata parser must match the Kotlin metadata version. They can't advance on the current stack — Kotlin 2.3+ forces the KSP2 backend (which crashes this project: KspAAWorkerAction 'unexpected jvm signature V'), and a Kotlin-2.2+-capable Hilt (2.59+) requires AGP 9 + Gradle 9. Gate behind dashboard approval so they never auto-PR; do them together as one upgrade. See CLAUDE.md 'Deferred toolchain upgrade'.

Dagger/Hilt compiler+runtime join the held Kotlin toolchain group above (Hilt 2.59+ requires AGP 9). The androidx.hilt:* wrappers are independent and update with AndroidX. NB: the matchDepNames rule above also catches the Hilt Gradle plugin marker `com.google.dagger.hilt.android` — the `com.google.dagger:**` glob here only matches the colon-form artifact coordinates, not the plugin id, which is how the v2.59.2 plugin PR (#14) slipped past the gate.
Android Gradle Plugin: block the v9 major (requires Gradle 9 and pulls in the held Kotlin/Hilt upgrade); allow 8.x updates.
Gradle wrapper: block the v9 major (coupled to the AGP 9 upgrade); allow 8.x updates, which also refresh distributionSha256Sum.

androidx.core requires AGP 9.1 + compileSdk 37 from 1.19.0 — cap below the v9 wall until the coordinated AGP 9 / Gradle 9 / Kotlin / Hilt upgrade. Stays in the AndroidX group, just pinned lower. See CLAUDE.md 'Deferred toolchain upgrade'.

androidx.lifecycle requires AGP 9.1 + compileSdk 37 from 2.11.0 — cap below the v9 wall until the coordinated AGP 9 / Gradle 9 / Kotlin / Hilt upgrade. Stays in the AndroidX group, just pinned lower. See CLAUDE.md 'Deferred toolchain upgrade'.

Room 2.7.0 replaced Gson with kotlinx-serialization for schema-bundle parsing; with exportSchema=true the room-compiler deserializes the schema JSON at KSP time and its generated $$serializer classes need a newer kotlinx-serialization-core than the pinned 1.7.3 (AbstractMethodError on typeParametersSerializers()). Bumping serialization risks forcing Kotlin 2.1+, so hold Room at 2.6.x until the coordinated upgrade. Stays in the AndroidX group, just pinned lower. See CLAUDE.md 'Deferred toolchain upgrade'.
All other AndroidX libraries in one PR (includes the androidx.hilt:* wrappers, which are independent of the Dagger/Hilt compiler).
Jetpack Compose (BOM + artifacts) grouped separately from the rest of AndroidX.
security-crypto is alpha; never auto-open a PR — surface it on the dashboard for manual approval. Own groupName so the approval gate doesn't propagate to the rest of the AndroidX group.
